'''Junyan''' is an NPC in [[Jinzhou]], found by Jinhzou Theater stage next to [[Xiaobao]]. A big fan of the play ''Fiamma'', who [[Qinghe]] plays as the main character.

==Location==
{{Map Embed|Jinzhou|97;90|nogroup=1}}

==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Day)
:'''Xiaobao''': Why haven't we started yet?
:'''Junyan''': Easy there, kiddo, Sister Qinghe won't be here until tonight.
:'''Xiaobao''': So what about now? The big bad guy is about to show up, where is the big hero? I want to see it now!
<!--::{{A|VO Siqi 01.ogg}} "{{tx}}"-->

;<nowiki>22:00-05:59</nowiki>
:What a dazzling performance! When those sparks flew, the whole theater lit up like gold. Kindle truly lives up to its name!
:Bravo, bravo! The moment Fiamma struggled to rise, gripping that flaming blade... Her determination was as fierce as the fire itself! Bravo!
:'''Junyan''':  Today's show was really something. Just when I thought we were at the end of the line, the fire blazed and Fiamma showed up!
:'''Qinghe''': Thank you, everyone! Fiamma couldn't be wielding the Torch Sword without your support!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(First interaction)
:'''Junyan''': I know how desperate he wants to see the show, but he's being annoying now... Oh, hello. Is there anything I can help?
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Junyan''': I know all the regular fans who come to watch the show, but this is the first time I've seen you.
::'''Junyan''': Are you here to watch the Hero Play too?
::{{DIcon}} Hello.
::'''Junyan''': Hello, I'm Junyan. I've seen all the plays performed at the Jinzhou Theater.
::'''Junyan''': Let me pick a show for you, the Liondance Troupe's "Vanguard Tiger's Song". During the performance, the lion will be rolling up and down on the Plum Blossom Pole. Quite a feat! 
::'''Junyan''': But if you ask me, the best is still the Hero Play performed by Qinghe, and her role as the Fiamma!
::'''Junyan''': As long as Fiamma shows up, any trouble can be solved!
::'''Junyan''': Even this kid next to me can settle down and enjoy the show.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
----
;(Second interaction)
:'''Junyan''': I know how desperate he wants to see the show, but he's being annoying now... Oh, hello. Is there anything I can help?
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Junyan''': {{Rover}}? Here to watch Sister Qinghe's show again?
::'''Junyan''': I told you, her acting is top-notch!
::'''Junyan''': But you've got bad timing, it seems like there's a new play about to start, and Sister Qinghe is still backstage, busy with the final preparations!
::{{DIcon}} I remember your face.
::{{DIcon}} Are you a longtime fan?
::'''Junyan''': Betcha. I've watched her grow step by step to where she is today.
::'''Junyan''': There was a time when I was really down, feeling like nothing was going my way. It was the Speedster who gave me the courage to face adversity!
::'''Junyan''': The Fiamma that came after, ignited a flame in my heart, giving me the confidence to face the complexities of life.
::'''Junyan''': That's why I love Qinghe's plays so much!
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
----
;(Third interaction)
:'''Junyan''': I know how desperate he wants to see the show, but he's being annoying now... Oh, hello. Is there anything I can help?
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Junyan''': {{Rover}}, thank god you're here. Can you help me talk some sense into this kid?
::'''Junyan''': He's been nagging to see the new play, but Qinghe is still in rehearsal!
::'''Junyan''': I've been explaining this to him, but he just won't listen. *sigh* I'm kind of desperate now...
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
----
:'''Junyan''': I know how desperate he wants to see the show, but he's being annoying now... Oh, hello. Is there anything I can help?
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Junyan''': I really don't know what to do, but I'm glad that you could help.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
----
:'''Junyan''': I know how desperate he wants to see the show, but he's being annoying now... Oh, hello. Is there anything I can help?
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Junyan''': Xiaobao seems to be behaving better, did you talk to him? I can't thank you enough, Rover.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
----
:'''Junyan''': I know how desperate he wants to see the show, but he's being annoying now... Oh, hello. Is there anything I can help?
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Junyan''': Qinghe will take the stage and I'll just wait here without any nuisance. Perfect!
::'''Junyan''': I hope her new play will be ready soon. I can't wait to see the new show!
::'''Junyan''': Once I pick up the Torch Sword, I will eradicate that monster! I haven't forgotten a single line!
::'''Junyan''': Can't wait to see Fiamma's brand new adventure story!
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
----
;(Night)
:'''Junyan''': Sister Qinghe is really amazing, don't you think?
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Junyan''': You're back! I've got a big news for you! The sequel to the Speedster's story is almost here!
::'''Junyan''': Last time, the story of the Speedster ended at the crucial moment of standoff with the final boss, it really killed me with suspense!
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}
